breakdown.description: The 2D line traction on the top edge is reinterpreted as a 3D surface pressure
breakdown.reason: The generated specification only states 'Use the XDMF base filename q2_displacement.xdmf.' It makes no mention of how to interpret the top-edge load. It neither corrects the erroneous 3D pressure interpretation nor aligns with the ground truth's correct instruction to treat the load as a 2D line traction per unit out-of-plane thickness. The inconsistency is therefore not resolved.
